6fc0ee9be9.q: How does Rotem Lurie balance personal identity with the demands of leading Venice Security as a founder?
6fc0ee9be9.a: Rotem uses her family—her mom, dad, and husband—as her compass to ensure she remains a good person. She initially feared becoming arrogant or treating people as tools to reach goals, but has learned that the journey changes you for good. She now focuses on ensuring she is happy with the changes the founder journey brings rather than resisting all change.
6fc0ee9be9.e: Rotem Lurie (Venice Security) on Intuition, Sacrifice, and Leading as a Woman
6fc0ee9be9.rq: As women, we're given an amazing intuition. This is just something that we have. We have it in our guts. And at the beginning, I feel like I always had the intuition of what I need to be doing, but I wasn't able to count on that and to rely on that intuition unless I was able to rationalize it.

71f787f936.q: What role does intuition play in Rotem Lurie's decision-making at Venice Security?
71f787f936.a: Rotem emphasizes that women have strong intuition and she has learned to trust hers, especially regarding people. In the early stage business, people buy because they like and trust you as a person and your team as human beings. She now relies on gut feelings about whether someone is genuinely interested in the business journey, and learns the rational reasons later. Her confidence grew after multiple instances where she ignored her intuition and later realized it had been right all along.

6a65637869.q: Why did Rotem Lurie's mother reject admission to Talpiot military academy?
6a65637869.a: Rotem's mother was the only woman accepted to Talpiot in her class but chose not to attend because she was the only woman. She instead went to Mamram where she was very successful. This choice not to be the sole woman in her cohort influenced Rotem's understanding of female leadership and representation.

5e16b4e59b.q: What sacrifices has Rotem Lurie made as founder of Venice Security?
5e16b4e59b.a: Rotem has sacrificed parts of her humble personality and become more self-promotional to build the company. She is relocating from Israel to the United States, separating from her home and friends. She has also sacrificed time and hobbies—when asked recently what her hobbies are, she realized she does not have any and works constantly, though she loves it.
